text:
Priya Rao: Heads-up — Michael Ellis (SDE2) confirmed for onsite Mon 3/30. Candidate is PST and prefers morning. Need final checklist: rooms, badge access, laptop for coding exercise, ASL interpreter (requested), and travel reimbursement details.
Sam Patel: Got it. Panel is Ava, Jordan, and me. Can we aim for 10:00–12:30 PT with a 30m debrief after?
Jordan Lee: I can book rooms. Tentative: Conf A 10:00–11:30 (onsite interview), Conf B 11:45–12:45 (pairing + debrief). Will add 30m buffer.
Priya Rao: Thanks — can you include a Zoom link too (just in case)? Also need temporary badge access and parking instructions.
Jordan Lee: Calendar invite text draft:
```
Subject: Redwood Interview — Michael Ellis (SDE2)
When: Mon 3/30, 10:00–12:45 PT
Location: HQ — 3rd floor, Conf A/B + Zoom (see link)
Agenda:
  10:00–10:50 — System design (Ava)
  11:00–11:30 — Coding exercise (Jordan)
  11:45–12:15 — Pairing (Sam)
  12:15–12:45 — Debrief
Zoom: https://redwood.zoom.us/j/xxxxx
Notes: Candidate requests ASL interpreter. Loaner laptop available on request.
```
Facilities: Temporary badge will be at lobby desk from 09:30–14:00 under "Michael Ellis". Parking: Visitor lot P2 (1st 2 hours free).
Priya Rao: Has the ASL interpreter been confirmed with vendor? Candidate indicated they need it for full day.
Sam Patel: Confirmed — vendor booked 09:45–13:15. We have interpreter name and contact; I'll DM Priya.
Jordan Lee: Also request for a loaner laptop. Please use this short form: `laptop-request: Michael Ellis | 3/30 | Ubuntu-22 | loaner` — IT will prepare and drop at Conf A.
Ava Chen: Please create the debrief doc and share rubric with panelists before Monday. Quick rubric link: https://redwood.internal/rubrics/sde2 (panelists should fill in before debrief).
Priya Rao: Reimbursement: candidate asked about transit reimbursement — send them this form: https://redwood.pay/reimburse and confirm receipts required within 30 days. I'll include in the invite.
TalentOps Bot: Background check for Michael Ellis: ✅ cleared (2026-03-18).
Priya Rao: Final checklist for Monday: rooms + Zoom (Jordan), badge + parking (Facilities), loaner laptop (Jordan/IT), ASL interpreter (Sam), invite with agenda + reimbursement link (Priya). I'll send consolidated invite by EOD Fri. Thanks all :pray:
Sam Patel: Perfect — will prep panel notes and pre-interview rubric reminders. :thumbsup:
Jordan Lee: Rooms booked and invites draft saved. Will push final invites after Priya's text update.
Priya Rao: Closing — I'll post the candidate Slack thread in #interviews once invites go out so panelists can ask any last-minute questions.
